After training, we sample 1,000 synthetic texts from each model, again with an equal distribution of labels. We evaluate the utility of the synthetic data with a BERT classifier. The classifier is trained on the synthetic texts for 5 epochs (learning rate = 2e-5), aimed at predicting the label corresponding to the instruction each sample was generated with.
